token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password={x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}.get('spotify'))['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists in library (paginate)
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

# Collect unique song ids across all playlists
song_ids=set()
playlist_song_counts=[]
for pl in all_playlists:
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=token)
    ids=[s['id'] for s in pl_detail.get('songs',[])]
    playlist_song_counts.append((pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'], len(ids)))
    song_ids.update(ids)

print('playlists_count', len(all_playlists))
print('playlist_song_counts', playlist_song_counts)
print('unique_song_ids', len(song_ids))

# For each song, check genre and collect classical artists
classical_song_ids=[]
classical_artist_ids=set()
classical_artist_names=set()

for sid in sorted(song_ids):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    if s.get('genre') == 'classical':
        classical_song_ids.append(sid)
        for a in s.get('artists',[]):
            classical_artist_ids.add(a['id'])
            classical_artist_names.add(a['name'])

print('classical_song_count', len(classical_song_ids))
print('classical_song_ids_sample', classical_song_ids[:20])
print('classical_artist_count', len(classical_artist_ids))
print('classical_artist_ids_sample', list(classical_artist_ids)[:30])
print('classical_artist_names_sample', list(classical_artist_names)[:30])

token = apis.spotify.login(username='jasonsimp@gmail.com', password={x['account_name']: x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}.get('spotify'))['access_token']

# Ensure we have the target classical artists from earlier computation
print('classical_artist_ids currently:', sorted(list(classical_artist_ids)))

# Re-fetch all following artists (paginated) for state-transition pre-check
following=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    following.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
following_ids = {a['artist_id'] for a in following}
print('following_artist_ids current:', sorted(list(following_ids)))

already = sorted(list(classical_artist_ids & following_ids))
need_action = sorted(list(classical_artist_ids - following_ids))
print('Already in target state:', already, '('+str(len(already))+')')
print('Need action:', need_action, '('+str(len(need_action))+')')

# Follow artists in delta set
results=[]
for aid in need_action:
    try:
        r = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=token)
        results.append((aid,'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((aid,'fail',str(e)))
print('follow results ok:', [x[0] for x in results if x[1]=='ok'])
print('follow results fail:', [(x[0],x[2]) for x in results if x[1]=='fail'])

# Verify by refetching following artists
following2=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    following2.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
following2_ids = {a['artist_id'] for a in following2}
print('Verification - classical artists now followed:', sorted(list(classical_artist_ids & following2_ids)))
print('Verification - classical artists missing:', sorted(list(classical_artist_ids - following2_ids)))
